title: Task board — local kanban HTML served by a zero-dep node server, launched via /task-status
description:
Visual task view + basic kanban editing for the local task store, without breaking the Jira-loss-free contract.

**Shape (human-decided):** `bin/task-board.js` starts a tiny HTTP server using only Node's `http` module (zero runtime deps, same constraint as the rest of bin/). It serves a single-page kanban — five columns matching the schema status enum (todo, in_progress, in_review, blocked, done) — with all CSS/JS inline (no CDN, works offline). Binds 127.0.0.1 only.

**Editing is status-only:** dragging a card between columns POSTs a transition that goes through `src/task-store.js` (atomic writes + index.json regeneration — never raw fs writes), so the board can't corrupt a ticket and every move maps 1:1 to a future Jira workflow transition. All other fields render read-only (key, title, priority, labels, AC count).

**Invocation:** a new `commands/task-status.md` plugin command launches the server and prints/opens the URL. Ships like the other entrypoints: esbuild bundle → `dist/task-board.cjs`, registered in shipped-bin.json.

Nice-to-have within scope: pick a free port automatically; clean shutdown (Ctrl+C / endpoint); board reflects on-disk changes on refresh.
acceptance_criteria: bin/task-board.js runs with zero runtime deps, binds 127.0.0.1 on a free port, serves the kanban HTML with inline assets, and exposes JSON endpoints: GET tasks (from the store) and POST status transition

POST transition validates the target status against the schema enum and persists exclusively through src/task-store.js (atomic write + index.json regeneration); an invalid transition returns an error and mutates nothing on disk
The board renders the five status columns with key, title, priority and labels per card; drag&drop between columns persists the new status and survives a page refresh
commands/task-status.md launches the server and surfaces the URL; plugin inventory tests updated
esbuild entry produces dist/task-board.cjs, added to shipped-bin.json, rebuild deterministic (empty git diff after fresh build)

E2E spec drives the HTTP surface end-to-end (start server → GET → POST transition → assert task file + index.json changed atomically) without a real browser; claude plugin validate . passes; full suite green
